item.title: Tyler Robinson's defense team files renewed request to disqualify Utah County Attorney's Office
item.description: The defense team for Tyler Robinson, the man accused of killing conservative influencer Charlie Kirk, has filed a renewed request for his case to be referred to the Utah Attorney General's Office and for the Utah County Attorney's Office to be dismissed.

item.title: Utah Attorney General's Office attends Bear River Massacre Memorial
item.description: On Thursday, a crowd gathered at the site of the Bear River Massacre that occurred 163 years ago in what is now Preston, Idaho.

item.title: Former West High School teacher sentenced for sex crimes against student
item.description: A former West High School teacher has been sentenced after being found guilty of sex-related crimes against a student at the school.

item.title: Judge again denies change of venue in Kouri Richins case, trial will go forward in Summit County
item.description: The Kamas mother accused of murdering her husband and writing a children's book about grief been denied a second request to move her trial from Summit County to Salt Lake County.

item.title: Gunlock Reservoir hits 100% capacity amid statewide drought
item.description: As much of Utah is experiencing low snowpack, Gunlock Reservoir in Southern Utah remains at around 100% capacity.

item.title: Ogden turns 175; founding documents to be displayed for first time at Union Station
item.description: Ogden City turns 175 years old this Friday and for the first time, the public is invited to see the original incorporation documents at Union Station.

item.title: Utah members of Congress, 11 local officials file redistricting lawsuit in federal court
item.description: Utah Representatives Celeste Maloy and Burgess Owens are among several elected officials who filed a federal lawsuit Monday to try to block Utah's newly implemented Congressional map from taking effect for the 2026 election.

item.title: Post Malone joins forces with Jelly Roll for second leg of tour, including stop in Utah
item.description: Utah's own Post Malone is gearing up for the second half of 'The BIG A** Stadium Tour,' which will include stops in 18 cities, including a Salt Lake City show in July.

item.title: New partnership could bring economic development to tribal lands in Washington County
item.description: A major new partnership could bring development to tribal land in Washington County, as Black Desert Resort and the Shivwits Band of Paiutes said they're in the early stages of exploring what development could look like.

item.title: Federal Government deals with third day of partial shutdown
item.description: The government entered its third day of a partial shutdown Monday, after Congress failed to approve the remaining six appropriation bills needed to fully fund the government Friday.
